Good morning. I bought this dress yesterday. Can I exchange it, please?
Of course. Do you have the receipt?
Yes, here it is. The dress is too tight on the shoulders.
I see. Would you prefer a different size, or would you rather have the money back?
Sorry, I don't understand. Can you say that again, please?
Sorry. A bigger size, or the money back?
The money back, please.
I am afraid you cannot get a refund on this one. It was in the sale, so exchange only.
I understand. Then can I have a bigger size? Do you have this in a large?
Let me check in the back. Yes, we have one in large, in blue and in black.
Can I try it on first? Where is the fitting room?
At the back, on your right. There is a big mirror inside. Take your time.
I understand. Then can I have a bigger size instead?

Welcome to the exchange desk. Please listen to this short message while you wait, because it answers almost every question. You can exchange any piece in thirty days, but you must bring the receipt and the tag must still be on the piece. If the piece has a defect, you can have your money back, and you can do that at any time. If there is no defect, we are sorry, but you cannot have the money back: it is exchange only. Pieces from the sale are always exchange only, even in the first week. If you bought online and you want to exchange in the store, that is fine, and you do not pay anything. And if you are not sure about a size, remember that you can always try it on first, as many times as you want. Thank you for waiting.

Hello, this is Daniel from the store on Oxford Street, calling for Patricia. It is about the dress you exchanged on Tuesday. I have good news and one small thing. The good news is that the large size in black arrived this morning, so now you can choose between blue and black, and you can change your mind if you prefer. The small thing is that I need you to bring the receipt again when you come, because the system asks for the number. If you cannot come before Sunday, do not worry: I keep both dresses here with your name until the end of the month. And one last thing you asked me about: yes, you can try both on, and there is no limit. See you soon.
Good morning. I bought this dress yesterday. Can I exchange it, please? Here is the receipt. It is too tight on the shoulders. Thank you very much.
